node.title: EF full-orbit pole-free cycle descent
node.statement: In the B-defined extension-fiber incidence with B-defined extension-pole divisor, any full Galois orbit of horizontal components avoiding the pole divisor has a B-defined reduced cycle as its union, and that cycle is still disjoint from the pole divisor.
node.attack_surface: standard Galois descent for the orbit cycle and B-defined closed divisors
node.falsifier: a Galois orbit of components disjoint from a B-defined divisor whose reduced union is not B-defined or meets the divisor
